questions.question: What's the key difference between a Platform Event and a Change Data Capture (CDC) event?
options: They are the same feature with two different names
A Platform Event is a custom-defined business event you publish yourself; CDC automatically publishes change events for objects you enable
CDC is for custom objects only; Platform Events are for standard objects only
Platform Events can only be consumed inside Salesforce, never externally
questions.explanation: Platform Events are custom-defined and explicitly published via EventBus.publish(); CDC is automatic record-change notification for objects you've enabled.

questions.question: Which Apex call publishes a custom Platform Event?
options: insert event;
Database.publish(event)
System.enqueueJob(event)
EventBus.publish(event)
questions.explanation: Platform Events are published via EventBus.publish(), not a plain DML insert.

questions.question: Why is polling for new events an anti-pattern once Platform Events or CDC are available?
options: It reintroduces batch-style latency into what's meant to be a near-real-time, push-based pattern
Polling is technically impossible in Salesforce
Polling uses less API bandwidth than subscribing
There is no downside to polling instead of subscribing
questions.explanation: Platform Events/CDC exist specifically to push changes to subscribers; a scheduled job that "checks for events" throws away that real-time benefit.

questions.question: Why should event subscribers be designed to be idempotent and tolerant of slight reordering?
options: Events are always delivered in perfect order, this is just a best practice with no real cause
Idempotency is required by Salesforce's terms of service
Event delivery isn't guaranteed to be instantaneous or strictly ordered across unrelated records
Reordering only happens in sandbox orgs, never production
questions.explanation: Designing for occasional reordering and possible redelivery makes subscribers robust to the real-world behavior of distributed event delivery.

questions.question: You need to notify an external system the moment a custom "Order Shipped" business moment happens, with a custom payload (carrier, tracking number). What's the better fit?
options: CDC — it's always the better choice for any event scenario
Platform Events, since CDC only reflects field changes, not a custom business payload
Neither — this requires a nightly batch job
Salesforce Connect, since it's about external data
questions.explanation: CDC mirrors field-level changes on records; a bespoke business event with its own custom fields needs a Platform Event you define yourself.
